fusions.name: Full Gallop Thrust
fusions.desc: Thrusts at a target up to 6 tiles away for 12 damage, rising to 1.3 times that at full reach, and knocks it back 3 tiles. Its damage rises with the distance you have travelled (max 30%).

fusions.name: Cavalry Lunge
fusions.desc: Drives forward through a cone 5 tiles long, dealing 26 damage to everything in it. If it hits, every ally strikes 20% harder for 15 seconds.

fusions.name: Thread the Ranks
fusions.desc: Carries you 5 tiles forward. Your movement speed rises 20% for 4 seconds afterwards.

fusions.name: Gathering Pace
fusions.desc: Every hit you land builds a stack on you, up to 6. When you reach 6, they all spend at once: you move and attack 5% faster per stack (27% at full) for 6 seconds. Unfed, a stack fades every 6 seconds.
